evals.prompt: The segmentation step in workers/ml/segmentation is currently an echo stub. Wire it up to call fal.ai's background-removal model, cache the result keyed on the source image hash, and record lineage (source asset, model + version, params, cost, confidence) before returning the derived asset.
evals.expected_output: The agent restates the doc-10 requirement for a new AI call (schema, why deterministic code is insufficient, cost/latency budget, cache key, fallback, eval) before writing code; the fal.ai SDK call lives only in workers/ml/segmentation (or apps/api/src/platform/ if the API side needs a client), never inside apps/api/src/modules/media/internal/; the response includes a provenance marker + confidence; the agent reports which doc-10 entry it filled in or states that it stopped because the entry is missing.
assertions: The agent explicitly names the doc-10 entry fields (schema, cost/latency budget, cache key, fallback, eval) before or instead of writing the fal.ai integration, per planning/10-ai-usage-cost-and-evaluation.md
No fal.ai SDK import appears inside apps/api/src/modules/media/internal/** — provider SDKs stay in workers/ml/segmentation or apps/api/src/platform/
The agent's plan or diff includes a lineage record (source asset, model + version, params, cost, confidence), not just the raw model output
If the doc-10 entry is missing or the eval/cost budget is undefined, the agent stops and reports the gap rather than shipping the call anyway

evals.prompt: Users report that when the try-on job fails partway through (fal.ai times out), the item is stuck showing a spinner forever in the app. Fix the pg-boss job so it retries with backoff and eventually surfaces a failed state the user can see.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies this as a job-handler + state-machine problem split across platform-engineer (the pg-boss handler) and api-engineer (the media module's failed/retry state), reproduces or describes the stuck-spinner failure mode, adds bounded retry with backoff and a DLQ path, and adds an idempotency/retry test in apps/api/src/modules/media/tests/ that demonstrably fails before the fix.
assertions: The agent names both the job-handler side and the media module's state-machine side of the fix, per this skill's Workflow step 3 agent split
The retry is bounded (an explicit max-attempts or backoff ceiling), not an unbounded loop
A regression test in apps/api/src/modules/media/tests/ is shown failing before the fix and passing after
The user-visible outcome is an explicit failed/retry state, not an indefinite spinner
The agent's report names `just test media` as a command it ran

evals.prompt: Before shipping the new classification model version, run the eval suite and tell me the accuracy delta and cost delta per 1k items versus the current model.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `just ml-eval`, and — since it is a documented P02 stub that exits 2 — reports honestly that the eval did not run rather than fabricating metrics, naming the phase task (T17) that will implement it.
assertions: The agent actually runs `just ml-eval` (or states it would) rather than inventing accuracy/cost numbers
The report states plainly that the eval is a stub in P02 and names the follow-up (T17) instead of fabricating a before/after metric
No cost-delta or accuracy claim appears in the report without a real command's output backing it
